data.desc: Texas Community Bancshares, Inc. is headquartered in Mineola, Texas. It is the bank holding company for Broadstreet Bank, SSB, a Texas -chartered savings bank also headquartered in Mineola ('Broadstreet'). Broadstreet offers a range of deposit products, including checking, money market, savings and certificate of deposit accounts. Its lending covers residential real estate, commercial real estate, construction and land, and municipal loans, along with commercial, consumer and other loans. Broadstreet serves customers through its main office and six branch offices in Franklin, Hopkins, Smith, Van Zandt and Wood Counties in East Texas.
